Subject: Duplicate charge on Invoice INV-2026-4012 — please advise / hold payment

Hi Sergio,

We noticed two identical charges for November on our account: INV-2026-4012 (£18,240) appears to have been posted twice — one on 2026-11-01 and again on 2026-11-02. Our finance team flagged the second charge when reconciling the card statement.

Could you please:
- Confirm whether this is a duplicate billing error,
- Place a hold on collections for the duplicate amount while you investigate, and
- Issue a provisional credit or advise the expected timeline to fix this?

We also have a EU VAT handling question: the invoice lists VAT at 0% but our tax team needs the supplier VAT ID to validate. Please attach the original invoice PDF and a statement we can share with our accountants.

Attaching the bank remittance screenshot (payment_receipt_1119.png) that shows the two charges.

Thanks for the quick turn — this is holding up our month-end close.

Best,
Olivia Harper

Nimbus Health

Hi Olivia,

Quick update and resolution:
- Monica confirmed this was a duplicate posting caused by a retries bug in an internal settlement job. We’ve reversed charge CHG-99837 and issued a provisional service credit for £18,240 against your account. The credit will appear on your next statement but we can apply it as a refund if you prefer.
- We attached the official credit note (credit_note-RDW-5421.pdf) and the corrected invoice PDF with supplier VAT ID (GB998877665) included.
- Collections hold removed for the corrected invoice; we will not attempt to collect the duplicated amount.

Actions for Nimbus: please confirm whether you want a refund to the card used (we will queue the refund after you confirm) or to have the credit applied against next month’s invoice. Also confirm receipt of the credit note for your records and for VAT reconciliation.
